summary_zh: 本页为绘本《苏武牧羊》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、审校者及出版社信息，画面描绘了苏武在荒凉山野中牧羊的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh: 汉朝初年，北方匈奴时常骚扰边境，挑起战争，边境的百姓苦不堪言。
page_text_en: In the early Han Dynasty, the northern Xiongnu frequently harassed the border regions, sparking wars, and the people living near the border suffered greatly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了汉朝初年北方匈奴侵扰边境的场景，文字说明边境百姓因战乱而生活困苦。

page_text_ocr_zh:
匈奴且鞮侯单于即位后，他怕汉朝乘他刚当上国王，国事还不稳定，派兵来攻打，就主动向汉朝示好。
汉武帝被他的诚意所打动，决定派遣苏武等人出使匈奴，商议长久和平的大计。
page_text_en:
After the Xiongnu chanyu, Xianyidi, ascended the throne, he feared that the Han dynasty might attack while his kingdom was still unstable. So he took the initiative to show goodwill to the Han court.
Emperor Wu of Han, moved by his sincerity, decided to send Su Wu and others on a diplomatic mission to the Xiongnu to discuss a long-term peace agreement.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了匈奴单于向汉朝示好，汉武帝决定派遣苏武等人出使匈奴，商议和平大计的历史场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
苏武带领汉朝使团一百来人，手持节杖，跋山涉水，来到西域。
单于并没有想象中那么友好，但也不敢为难他们。
可是，就在苏武等人完成使命，准备回归的时候，发生了一件大事。
page_text_en:
Su Wu led a Han dynasty delegation of about a hundred people, holding ceremonial staffs, crossing mountains and rivers to reach the Western Regions.
The chanyu was not as friendly as expected, but he also dared not trouble them.
However, just as Su Wu and his companions had completed their mission and were preparing to return, a major incident occurred.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了苏武带领汉朝使团跋山涉水抵达西域的场景，并说明单于虽不友好但未加为难，然而在使团准备归国时，发生了一件重大事件。

page_text_ocr_zh:
单于的亲信卫律，原是汉朝的官员，后来投靠匈奴。卫律的部将虞常，一直不满卫律卖主求荣，决定趁这次汉朝使团来，杀掉卫律，再挟持单于的母亲回汉朝将功赎罪。他找到了汉朝使团的副使张胜，希望他能助自己一臂之力。张胜满口答应了。
可是消息败露，虞常等人还没行动就被抓了。汉朝使团因此也受到了牵连。
page_text_en:
The Chanyu's trusted aide, Wei Lu, was originally an official of the Han dynasty who later defected to the Xiongnu. Wei Lu's subordinate, Yu Chang, had long been dissatisfied with Wei Lu's betrayal of his lord for personal gain. He decided to take advantage of the current Han envoy's visit to assassinate Wei Lu and then seize the Chanyu's mother to return to the Han dynasty and redeem himself for his crimes. He found Zhang Sheng, the deputy envoy of the Han delegation, and hoped he could lend him a helping hand. Zhang Sheng readily agreed.
However, the plot was exposed, and Yu Chang and his companions were arrested before they could act. As a result, the Han envoy delegation was also implicated.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了匈奴部将虞常因不满卫律卖主求荣，密谋刺杀卫律并挟持单于母亲归汉，却因计划泄露而被捕，导致汉朝使团也受到牵连。

page_text_ocr_zh:
单于大怒，派人把苏武抓来审问。苏武断然否认使团参与谋反。
回到营帐，苏武对随行使臣说：“我未能完成使命，还让国家蒙受耻辱，有何面目回汉！”说完拔剑就要自刎。
page_text_en:
The Chanyu became furious and sent people to arrest Su Wu for interrogation. Su Wu firmly denied that the delegation was involved in the rebellion.
Back in the tent, Su Wu told his fellow envoys, "I failed to complete my mission and have brought shame upon my country. How can I face my homeland?" He then drew his sword and was about to commit suicide.
summary_zh: 单于因谋反事件大怒，派人审问苏武，苏武否认参与；回到营帐后，他因未能完成使命、有辱国家而悲愤欲绝，拔剑自刎。

page_text_ocr_zh:
所幸，他被身边人及时救下，并未伤到要害。
单于听说了这事，对苏武肃然起敬，心想：
这样的血性男儿，又满怀文韬武略，与其杀了他，
不如劝他投降，为我效力。
于是，单于派良医给苏武治伤，让卫律前来劝降。
卫律先以利诱，后又威逼，苏武始终不为所动，
只是说：“要杀就杀，不杀就放我回汉。”
page_text_en:
Fortunately, he was rescued by those around him in time and did not suffer serious injury.
When the Chanyu heard about this, he was deeply impressed by Su Wu and thought:
Such a man of courage, and full of wisdom and martial skill—rather than kill him,
it would be better to persuade him to surrender and serve me.
So, the Chanyu sent a skilled doctor to treat Su Wu's wounds and ordered Wei Lu to come and try to persuade him to defect.
Wei Lu first tried to tempt him with promises, then threatened him, but Su Wu remained unmoved,
only saying: "If you must kill me, then kill me; if not, let me return to Han."
summary_zh: 苏武自刎被救后，单于对其肃然起敬，决定劝其投降。卫律先后以利诱和威逼劝降，但苏武坚决不从，表示宁愿死也不愿背叛汉朝。

page_text_ocr_zh:
卫律把苏武的情况报告了单于。
单于拍案而起：“好一个苏武！我偏不杀你，
也不放你。来人呐，赐苏武公羊百只，流放北海。
告诉他，公羊什么时候生下小羊，他就可以回汉。”
page_text_en:
Wei Lu reported Su Wu's situation to the Chanyu.
The Chanyu slammed his fist on the table: "What a Su Wu! I won't kill you,
but I won't let you go either. Bring me! Grant Su Wu a hundred male sheep, exile him to the Northern Sea.
Tell him, when the male sheep gives birth to a lamb, he may return to Han."
summary_zh: 单于得知苏武宁死不降后，将其流放至北海，并以公羊生小羊的不可能条件作为归国前提，以此羞辱和惩罚他。

page_text_ocr_zh:
茫茫北海，苏武拄着节杖，领着羊群，艰难前行。
这北海竟是一片“死海”，是匈奴专门用来流放
犯人的地方，别说人烟荒芜，就是植被也极其稀少。
page_text_en:
In the vast Northern Sea, Su Wu, leaning on his ceremonial staff, leads a flock of sheep forward with great difficulty.
This Northern Sea is actually a "dead sea," a place the Xiongnu specifically use to exile criminals. Not only is it desolate and uninhabited, but vegetation is also extremely scarce.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了苏武被流放至北海，在荒凉的环境中拄着节杖带领羊群艰难前行的场景，文字说明北海是匈奴流放犯人的荒芜之地。

page_text_ocr_zh:
第一年，苏武几次险些丧命。
有一回为了寻找水源，苏武走了一天一夜，却
一直在同一个地方打转。眼看携带的水就要喝完了，
苏武用节杖支撑着疲惫的身躯，一路走，一路堆放
石头，摆成特殊的形状，以便认路。
当喝到那一口甘甜的泉水时，苏武瘫软倒下，半
天都动弹不了。
page_text_en:
In the first year, Su Wu nearly lost his life several times.
Once, while searching for water, Su Wu walked for a day and night, yet
he kept going in circles. As the water he carried was about to run out,
Su Wu used his staff to support his exhausted body, placing stones along the way
into special shapes to help him find his path.
When he finally drank from that sweet spring, Su Wu collapsed, unable to move for
half a day.
summary_zh: 本页描述了苏武被流放至北海后的第一年，因寻找水源而险些丧命，他靠节杖支撑身体，用石头标记路线，最终找到泉水后因极度虚弱而瘫倒。

page_text_ocr_zh:
一天夜里，苏武和羊群正在岩石下休息，
猛然听得远处“啊呜啊呜”的狼叫声，又见两
双磷火般的眼睛朝他们快速接近。慌乱之中，
他燃起火把，拼命挥动，羊群不安地挤在他身后。
两匹饿狼最终带走了两只羊，还在
苏武腿上留下一个碗口大的咬痕。
page_text_en:
One night, Su Wu and his flock were resting under the rocks,
when suddenly he heard the distant howling of wolves, 'Awo Awo,' and saw two
pairs of eyes glowing like phosphorus approaching them rapidly. In panic,
he lit a torch and waved it frantically, while the sheep huddled anxiously behind him.
Two hungry wolves eventually carried away two sheep, and left
a bite wound the size of a bowl on Su Wu's leg.
summary_zh: 苏武在北海流放期间，夜间与羊群在岩石下休息时遭遇饿狼袭击，他点燃火把驱赶，但仍有两只羊被叼走，自己腿部也被咬伤。

page_text_ocr_zh: 那一年冬天，北海变成了雪海。苏武和羊群被困在了一个山洞里，没有吃的，也没有喝的，他们随时可能会被严寒吞没。羊群早已成了苏武同生共死的伙伴，他丝毫没有打它们的主意。渴了，他就嚼冰雪；饿了，他就到雪地里去挖老鼠洞，吃老鼠们为过冬准备的草籽和粮食；有时几天没有收获，他就薅羊毛充饥，他也会忍痛吃掉那些饿死的羊；夜里，他就睡在羊群中间取暖。
page_text_en: That winter, the Northern Sea turned into a sea of snow. Su Wu and his flock were trapped in a mountain cave, with no food and no water, and they were at constant risk of being swallowed by the harsh cold. The flock had long become Su Wu's companions in life and death, and he never even thought of harming them. When thirsty, he chewed on ice and snow; when hungry, he dug into mouse holes in the snow to eat the seeds and food the mice had stored for winter; when he went days without finding anything, he would pull wool from the sheep to eat, and sometimes he would painfully eat the sheep that had starved to death; at night, he slept among the flock to keep warm.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了苏武被流放至北海后，在一个严寒的冬天与羊群被困于山洞，他依靠冰雪充饥、挖鼠洞觅食、薅羊毛充饥，并在羊群中间取暖，展现了其在极端恶劣环境下的生存困境与坚韧意志。

page_text_ocr_zh:
当冰雪融化，一场雨露让北海现出春天的生机时，骨瘦如柴的苏武和羊群也跟着活了过来。
苏武再也没有轻生的念头：既然你不让我死，我就好好活给你看。只要活着，我就还有回汉的一天！
page_text_en:
When the ice and snow melted and a spring rain brought life to the Northern Sea, the emaciated Su Wu and his flock of sheep also came back to life.
Su Wu no longer had any thoughts of suicide: If you won't let me die, then I'll live well for you to see. As long as I'm alive, I still have a day to return to Han!
summary_zh: 苏武在北海度过寒冬后，冰雪融化、春回大地，他与羊群重获生机，重燃归汉希望，决心坚强活下去。

page_text_ocr_zh:
以后的日子似乎没有那么难了。
苏武在一处水源旁，挨着岩石壁，搭起了一座简易的
木屋，又围起了羊圈。他自制弓箭、鱼叉，来捕获猎物；
衣服破了，就披上兽皮；鞋子破了，就用树皮编织；他的
头发、胡须越来越长，看起来像一个野人。
page_text_en:
The days that followed seemed less difficult.
Su Wu, by a source of water and beside a rock wall, built a simple wooden hut and fenced in a sheep pen. He made his own bows, arrows, and fish spears to hunt for food; when his clothes tore, he covered himself with animal skins; when his shoes wore out, he wove them from tree bark; his hair and beard grew longer and longer, making him look like a wild man.
summary_zh: 苏武在北海找到水源后，搭建了简易木屋和羊圈，自制工具捕猎，用兽皮和树皮修补衣物，因长期艰苦生活，头发胡须变长，形同野人。

page_text_ocr_zh:
每当仰望星空的时候，他就会思念远方的家乡和亲人，也会想起未完成的使命。
每当大雁南飞的时候，他总是一遍又一遍地抚摸着节杖，并在上面刻下一道印痕。
就这样，一天又一天过去了，一年又一年过去了。那根早已斑驳的节杖上多了十九道深深的刻痕。
page_text_en:
Whenever he looked up at the stars, he would miss his distant hometown and loved ones, and remember his unfinished mission.
Whenever the geese flew south, he would stroke the staff again and again, carving a mark on it.
This way, day after day, year after year passed. The already weathered staff now bore nineteen deep grooves.
summary_zh: 苏武在北海流放期间，每当仰望星空或大雁南飞时，便思念家乡和未完成的使命，并在节杖上刻下记号，记录时光流逝，节杖上已刻有十九道深痕。

page_text_ocr_zh:
在这十九年里，单于始终没有放弃对苏武的劝降。每隔一段时间，他就派人过来看看苏武是不是还活着，有时也给他带来一些必需的生活用品。
单于托人告诉苏武，只要他愿意，随时可以当高官，但苏武一次都没有犹豫过。
page_text_en:
For these nineteen years, the Chanyu never gave up trying to persuade Su Wu to surrender. From time to time, he sent people to check whether Su Wu was still alive, and sometimes brought him some necessary daily supplies.
The Chanyu told Su Wu through messengers that if he wished, he could become a high official at any time, but Su Wu never hesitated even once.
summary_zh: 本页描述了苏武在北海流放的十九年间，单于多次派人劝降并提供生活用品，但苏武始终拒绝投降，表现出坚定的气节。

page_text_ocr_zh:
唯有李陵将军的那一次到来，让苏武陷入了深深的迷茫。
李陵原是他在汉朝的挚友，没想到他在一次战事中被逼无奈，也投靠了匈奴。李陵告诉苏武，他在汉朝的父母都已经病逝，两个兄弟以为他投降匈奴而畏罪自杀了，他的妻儿也不知道流落何方。
苏武老泪纵横，沉默了许久，最后他说了一句：“如果你还念及旧情，以后就请你别来了。”
page_text_en:
The only time General Li Ling came, it plunged Su Wu into deep confusion.
Li Ling was once his close friend in the Han dynasty, but unexpectedly, he had been forced to surrender to the Xiongnu during a battle. Li Ling told Su Wu that his parents in the Han dynasty had already passed away, his two brothers had committed suicide out of fear of being blamed for his surrender, and his wife and children were nowhere to be found.
Su Wu wept bitterly, remained silent for a long time, and finally said, "If you still remember our old friendship, please don't come again."
summary_zh: 李陵前来劝降苏武，告知其家人已亡、妻儿失散，苏武悲痛万分，最终拒绝劝降并请李陵不要再来了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
公元前81年，匈奴和汉朝结束了长达数十年的战争，双方议和，开始了正常的邦交往来。
这一年，苏武已年届花甲。他披着满头的白发，手持已脱尽节毛的节杖，带着当年汉朝使团剩下的九人，回汉复命了。
page_text_en:
In 81 BC, the Xiongnu and the Han Dynasty ended their decades-long war, reached a peace agreement, and began normal diplomatic relations.
That year, Su Wu was already in his sixties. With a head full of white hair, he held a staff whose decorative fur had all fallen off, and led the nine remaining members of the original Han diplomatic mission back to Han to report.
summary_zh: 公元前81年，苏武在被流放十九年后，终于与汉朝使团的幸存者一同返回汉朝，他满头白发，手持已无节毛的节杖，象征着其坚守气节、历经磨难的归国之路。
画面描绘了三只羊在山石上休憩，天空中一群大雁向南飞去，背景是连绵的山峦，暗示着季节更替与归乡的意象。
